title: Tandemesh — icon concepts
subtitle: First round · three directions · pure black SVG on a 256 px grid, monochrome by design

concepts.name: Fin
concepts.idea: A dorsal fin breaking a plane: a pod of machines running as one, all of them moving the same way.
concepts.risk: Risk: reads as a sail or a wave until the orca story lands. Worth a check against Docker's whale.

concepts.name: Shear
concepts.idea: The T of Tandemesh, cut on one 10° shear: a plane that is already in motion, legible at 16 px.
concepts.risk: Risk: a sheared T can read as type rather than a mark; the cut has to be drawn, not typed.

concepts.name: Stream
concepts.idea: Two chevrons, one direction: runs entering the plane, clearing it, and handing off to the next.
concepts.risk: Risk: fast-forward is a crowded sign, and it reads as rewind when mirrored.

footer:
Tests run on all three: 16 / 32 / 64 px, one-colour, dark app tile, mirror, 180° rotation, squint blur, and an SVG structural audit (no text, no raster, no filters, whole-degree angles — all three score 100).
Lockup type is provisional (Inter). Colour, variants and guidelines come with the kit for whichever direction you pick.
